note: Constraints are transcribed from the vendor API reference. Every rule carries a source key so a failing lint can be traced back to a primary document rather than to a blog post.

duration_seconds.common_error: Many secondary write-ups state a 5-second minimum. The API reference accepts 4.

resolutions.common_error: 1080p and 4K are frequently claimed and are not offered. 2K here means a 1440px short edge.

aspect_ratios.common_error: aspect_ratio is a derived value once an image is attached; sending one anyway is silently ignored.

reference_inputs.common_error: 9 + 3 + 3 is 15, but the total cap is 12. Requests that satisfy every per-type limit can still exceed the total.

high_resolution_path.description: The 768P result is fed back through the model with the original context and generated again, rather than upscaled. Frame n of the 2K render is not the same instant as frame n of the 768P render.
